sloka: तमभ्युपेत्याद्भुतघोरवीर्यं स कुम्भकर्णो युधि वानरेन्द्रम्।जहार सुग्रीवमभिप्रगृह्य यथा ऽनिलो मेघमतिप्रचण्डः ।। ६.६७.६९ ।।
transliteration: tamabhyupetyādbhutaghoravīryaṁ sa kumbhakarṇo yudhi vānarendram।jahāra sugrīvamabhipragṛhya yathā 'nilo meghamatipracaṇḍaḥ ।। 6.67.69 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the piece of mountain the Vanara king became unconscious and dropped on the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas were happy and naturally roared with a feeling of triumph.
